svg.text: The last human in the loop
HOW YOU DEPLOYED IN MODULES 10 TO 12
No review. No test. No scan. No approval. No record of who deployed what.
Deployable from an uncommitted working directory, from any laptop with credentials on it.
The cluster no longer matches Git, and nobody can tell.
Triggered by a commit, not a person. Every run is logged, attributed and repeatable.
The same steps run for everyone, every time, whether or not anyone is watching.
This is not about speed. Typing kubectl set image is already fast.
It is about the steps that a human under pressure will skip, and that a pipeline cannot.
The scan you ran once in Module 07 becomes the scan that runs on every commit forever.
